title: Explicitness/faithfulness: no concrete group is exhibited for the FIN-vs-VC separation

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
The problem demands **explicit** finitely generated groups. The solution refers only to 'the Leary–Petrosyan groups' and characterizes them solely by their properties (torsion-free, cocompact $E_{\FIN}$, $\gd_{\VC}=\infty$) in `thm:LP`/`thm:main`. It gives **no presentation, no generating set, and no concrete construction**.

The orientation in Remark `rem:blackbox` ('built from free abelian groups via graph-of-groups / ascending HNN constructions') is vague and is explicitly stated to be non-load-bearing. Consequently, even granting the cited theorem, the deliverable 'exhibit an explicit example' is met only by reference to the literature, not by an actual construction in the text.

To close: write down a concrete Leary–Petrosyan-type group by explicit presentation/generators (e.g. a specific Bestvina–Brady kernel or ascending HNN extension of $\mathbb Z^n$), verify torsion-freeness and a cocompact/finite-dimensional model for $E_{\FIN}$ directly, and pin the $\gd_{\VC}=\infty$ citation to that specific group. Note the problem only requires a **finite-dimensional** (not cocompact) $E_{\FIN}$, so a simpler explicit example may suffice.
